description: The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3. A forensic odontologist needs a 3D model of the patient's dentition for identification. Perform a high-density segmentation to isolate the teeth enamel (and dense petrous bone) from the rest of the skull. Create a mask with a Minimum Hounsfield Unit (HU) threshold of at least 1500 HU (range e.g., 1500 to 3071 HU). Generate a 3D surface from this mask and export it as a binary STL file to /home/ga/Documents/enamel_model.stl. Finally, save the project to /home/ga/Documents/enamel_project.inv3 to preserve the mask settings.
